# LEAD College (Autonomous)

> LEAD College (Autonomous) — formerly LEAD College of Management — is an
> AICTE-approved, autonomous business and technology institution in Dhoni,
> Palakkad, Kerala, India, affiliated to the University of Calicut. It offers
> industry-integrated, fully residential MBA and MCA programmes known for
> internships every semester, mentorship from seasoned professionals, and a
> consistent 90%+ placement record.

## Key facts

- **Official name:** LEAD College (Autonomous) (formerly "LEAD College of Management")
- **Location:** Dhoni PO, Palakkad, Kerala 678009, India
- **Affiliation:** University of Calicut (Autonomous status)
- **Founder:** Dr. Thomas George
- **Approvals & accreditation:** AICTE Approved · NAAC Accredited (B++) · NBA Accredited · ISO 21001:2018 Certified · UGC Recognised
- **Programmes:** MBA (2-year, full-time, residential, industry-integrated) · MCA · Doctoral / research (recognised research centre of KUFOS)
- **Distinctive model:** Internship every semester, fully residential campus, industry mentorship, leadership & entrepreneurship focus
- **Placements:** 90%+ placement consistency; 235+ recruiters including Federal Bank, HDFC Life, Axis Bank, HCL and others
- **Website:** https://www.lead.ac.in

- [Admissions](https://www.lead.ac.in/admissions): Eligibility, process and how to apply

- [IQAC / Quality & Accreditation](https://www.lead.ac.in/iqac): Accreditations, mandatory disclosures and quality assurance
